title: Active Pilot Sampling for Multi-fidelity Estimation in Stochastic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.27563v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stochastic optimization with high-fidelity nonlinear models is often computationally prohibitive because each objective evaluation requires sampling-based uncertainty quantification inside an outer optimization loop. Multi-fidelity estimators, such as approximate control variates (ACV), can reduce this cost by exploiting cheaper low-fidelity models, but they require model-output covariance information to determine control-variate weights and sample allocations. These covariances are generally unknown and must be estimated through pilot sampling. Existing pilot-sampling strategies primarily address one-off estimation and do not exploit the structure of iterative stochastic optimization, where covariance information may vary smoothly across the design domain and can be shared across optimization queries. translated_title: 面向随机优化中多保真度估计的主动先导采样方法
translated_abstract: 使用高保真非线性模型的随机优化在计算上往往难以承受，因为每次目标函数评估都需要在外层优化循环内部进行基于采样的不确定性量化。多保真度估计器（如近似控制变量法 ACV）可以通过利用更廉价低保真模型来降低这一成本，但它们需要模型输出的协方差信息来确定控制变量的权重和样本分配。这些协方差通常是未知的，必须通过先导采样来估计。现有的先导采样策略主要针对一次性估计，未能利用迭代随机优化的结构特点，即协方差信息在设计域上可能平滑变化，并且可以在不同的优化查询之间共享。我们提出了一种主动先导采样框架，利用概率方法学习模型输出协方差矩阵的概率代理模型……
tldr: 本文提出一种主动先导采样框架，通过学习模型输出协方差矩阵的概率代理模型，利用协方差在设计域上的平滑变化并在优化查询间共享信息，从而降低迭代随机优化中多保真度估计的采样成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an active pilot-sampling framework that learns a probabilistic emulator of the model-output covariance matrix, exploiting smoothly varying and shareable covariance information across optimization queries to reduce sampling costs in multi-fidelity stochastic optimization.
